material_request_rejection_inbounds:
CREATE TABLE material_request_rejection_inbounds (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	receipt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	return_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source_account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_location_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	custody_assignment_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_person_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_role_assignment_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	authorization_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	posting_transaction_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	accepted_qty NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	damaged_qty NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	recorded_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	trace_request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	plan_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	plan_jsonb JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(receipt_id, return_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_receipts (id, return_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_rejection_inbound_trace UNIQUE (actor_user_id, trace_request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_inbound_quantity CHECK (accepted_qty>0 AND damaged_qty>=0 AND damaged_qty<=accepted_qty), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_inbound_versions CHECK (request_version>0 AND authorization_version>0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_inbound_reason CHECK (length(trim(reason))>0), 
	UNIQUE (receipt_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(receipt_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_receipts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(return_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_returns (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES material_requests (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_location_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(custody_assignment_id) REFERENCES custody_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_person_id) REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_role_assignment_id) REFERENCES role_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (posting_transaction_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(posting_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash)
)
material_request_rejection_inbound_parts:
CREATE TABLE material_request_rejection_inbound_parts (
	inbound_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	condition_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	target_account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (inbound_id, condition_code), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_inbound_part CHECK (condition_code IN ('new','used','damaged') AND quantity>0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(inbound_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_inbounds (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
material_request_rejection_inbound_seria:
CREATE TABLE material_request_rejection_inbound_serials (
	inbound_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	serial_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	condition_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (inbound_id, serial_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(inbound_id, condition_code) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_inbound_parts (inbound_id, condition_code) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(serial_id) REFERENCES inventory_serials (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
